p: three years without war between Syria: Ben-hadad the king of Syria, and Ahab made a peace which endured three years.
came down to the king of: To see and visit him.
Ramoth in Gilead is ours: The kings of Syria kept Ramoth before this league was made by Benhadad: therefore he did not think he was bound by it to restore it.
I am as thou art: I am ready to join and go with you, and all of mine is at your command.
Enquire: He seemed that he would not go to war unless God approved it, yet when Michaiah advised the opposite he would not obey.
prophets together: Meaning the false prophets, who were liars and served for money whom Jezebel had assembled and kept after the death of those whom Elijah slew.
LORD besides: Jehoshaphat did not acknowledge the false prophets to be God's ministers, but contemned them.
I hate him: By which we see that the wicked cannot abide to hear the truth, but hate the prophets of God and molest them.
officer: Read Ge 37:36.
robes: In their kingly apparel.

horns of iron: The true prophets of God were accustomed to use signs for the confirmation of their doctrine, Isa 20:2, Jer 7:2 in which the false prophets imitated them, thinking by it to make their doctrine more believable.
one mouth: This is the common argument of the wicked, who think that no one should speak against anything if the majority approves of it, be they ever so ungodly.
Go: He speaks this in derision, because the king attributed so much to the false prophets, meaning that by experience he should discern that they were liars.
These have no master: It is better for them to return home than to be punished and scattered because they go to war without God's counsel and approval.
host of heaven standing by him: Meaning, his angels.
stood before the LORD: Here we see that though the devil is always ready to bring us to destruction, yet he has no more power than God gives him.
lying spirit in the mouth of: I will cause all his prophets to tell lies.
Which way went the Spirit of: Thus the wicked would that none were in the favour of God but they, and that God has given his graces to none so much as to them.
bread of affliction and with water: Let him waste away with hunger and be fed with a small portion of bread and water.
Hearken: That when you see these things come to pass you may give God the glory, and know that I am his true prophet.
cried out: That is, to the Lord for help.
king was stayed up in his: That is, Ahab, king of Israel.
host about the going down of: Of the Israelites.
the high places were not taken: Meaning, that he was led with an error, thinking that they might still sacrifice to the Lord in those places, as they did before the temple was built.
deputy was king: In the time of this king, Idumea was subject to Judah, and was governed by whom they of Judah appointed.
Tharshish to go to: By Tharshish the scripture means Cilicia and all the Mediterranean Sea.
Ophir for gold: Josephus writes that Ophir is in India, where the Egyptians and Arabians traffic for gold.
